name: Hill Inlet
bestView: Hill Inlet lookout at mid-tide: the swirl is sharpest when the tide is halfway in or out, not at low tide
bestMonths: May to October: dry season, stinger-free, 24°C
crowd: Day-trip boats land 09:30 to 14:00. Sailing trips that stay past 15:00 get the beach to themselves
kid: Shallow warm lagoon water, no stingers June to July, and the purest white sand they will ever stomp in
priceNote: The boat is the cost, not the beach. Compare sailing-day trips: cheap ones are day-cruises, good ones are sail.

visa.note: Almost everyone needs an ETA or eVisitor in advance — apply online before booking flights.
